name: AirHorn
description: Plays an AirHorn. Pitch Mode chooses fixed pitch, or tracking from the keyboard / Pitch parameter.

params.name: P.Mode
params.detail: Pitch mode: Fixed, or Key (NTS-1/mk2) / Pitch (NTS-3)

params.name: Pitch
params.detail: Continuous pitch ±2 oct when P.Mode=Pitch (NTS-3; center = unison)
